mn132:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn132:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ānando upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca bhāsati.
mn132:2.2: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenupaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn132:2.4: ko nu kho bhikkhave upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsīti.
